layout.timesMs: Workload order, then [Moyo samples, IndexedDB samples]. Raw floating-point timers are preserved without rounding.
layout.warmups: A warmup visit concatenates stock warmupSamples then its final rawSamples, all excluded from measured pools.
layout.contentChecksums: Workload order. One list shared by the two engines after exact equality checks; equal offsets match across variants.
layout.medianDefinition: Sort all measured samples in the stated pool; average the two middle values for an even count. Means are arithmetic. Positive latency change means slower.

harness.qualification: Measurements invoked an immutable prior runner copy. Delivered code differs only in two metadata filename-extension regexes whose unused groups became noncapturing for lint; workload and timing code is identical.

qualifications: Each launch uses a fresh persistent Chromium profile; sources have immutable separate origins whose assignments alternate between launches.
Stock workload run and verify functions, inputs, transaction boundaries, strict durability options and timed regions are unchanged.
An untimed prepare wrapper assigns successive stock random seeds to corresponding samples in both engines and both variants.
HTTP artifact bytes are verified before and after each launch, outside every timed sample; no cache-control or request interception is installed.
Fresh empty database open is not cold browser/network/module startup; warmups and stock release-profile detection precede measured samples.
Headless persistent browser storage and fsync costs are specific to this host; no hardware power-loss guarantee is inferred from timings.
Current main advanced during the investigation. All final headline/scaling rows were rerun on c90d16df versus c90d16df plus this patch. Earlier supporting results are separately marked historical.
Headline four-profile observations contain 8 Moyo samples per variant and 16 pooled strict IndexedDB controls per workload. Samples share profile/host conditions and are not independent machines.
Moyo runs before IndexedDB within each visit. The pooled IndexedDB median is a descriptive common denominator; it does not remove host drift.

IndexedDB explicit readwrite transactions request strict durability. indexedDB.open uses an implicit versionchange transaction with no API durability choice; fresh empty open compares API latency, not identical controllable flush policies.
Fresh empty open creates a new DB and Worker after capability/module preflight and warmups. It is not cold browser/network/module startup.
Small commits use 1000 independent commits of 128-byte values. Large-write inputs, batch boundaries and stock run/verify code are shared between engines and revisions.
Original 1000x64KiB and 64x1MiB writes verify all records; scaling rows with more than 1024 values use the stock evenly spaced 1024-record sample.
The deterministic value generator has repeating low-entropy patterns; arbitrary-entropy payload performance was not measured.
Append-offset caching and 4 MiB checkpoint writes are already in the common base; this patch claims no reduction in their calls or barriers.

checksum.kind: native checksum input-byte accounting over begin/put-many/commit with default checkpoints
checksum.qualification: Actual main is an isolated native checkout instrumented with a test-only counter and stock-shape fixture. Candidate generic/prepared paths are compared in the same ignored fixture. Counts are not wall-clock results. Metadata verification may differ by a few 4 KiB pages because clean-cache publication traverses a HashMap.

sourceDerived.kind: source-derived commit-planning copies and explicit overflow zero-fill requests; not measured DRAM traffic
sourceDerived.scope: 4 to 2 full payload copies inside commit planning; excludes SDK input/WAL/checkpoint gathering. Page checksum fields still receive final CRCs. Zero-fill counts are source-level requests; compiler/allocator behavior can differ. Prefix/Vec allocations are excluded from checksum metadata bytes.

qualifications: Only run-phase measured samples; prepare/verify/cleanup and diagnostic snapshots are excluded from these deltas.
elapsedMs still includes hooks. SDK/engine method timings nest storage timings; never sum them as disjoint phases.
Diagnostic timing includes hooks and is not a headline A/B; physical counts/bytes are the structural comparison.
Metadata operations are aggregated across filenames. One failed getFileHandle on fresh open is the expected missing root manifest; all hook error lists were empty.
Missing metric means zero calls. Sync read-byte retention may differ by a few metadata pages because clean LRU publication traverses a HashMap.

diagnosticLayerComparison.qualification: Instrumented browser diagnostic, two measured samples after one warmup. Engine boundary time includes generated JS bindings, WASM and nested storage; not pure CPU. Storage time is nested in engine time. Open includes cache-disabled diagnostic hooks and must not substitute for headline latency.

fullRegressionGuard.kind: full automatic stock regression guard; not headline latency evidence

environmentRetry.qualification: An initial after-variant browser launch failed before any workload because its previous external browser path disappeared. The successful retry used a local copy of the same binary, with exact Browser.getVersion equality asserted before running rows. No timed samples were discarded; Node remained 24.19.0.

cpuSampling.kind: 100 microsecond CPU sampling with symbol-bearing build; separate diagnostic
cpuSampling.qualification: Sampled self time is approximate; sampling overhead, symbol builds and sequential diagnostics prevent treating these times as the uninstrumented MoyoDB-vs-IndexedDB comparison. Baseline CPU runs were contended. Caller groups classify reported CRC caller stacks by preparation/overflow/publication substring, in that priority. Profiling and headline WASM artifacts are distinct.

treeMetadataAllocationRequests.qualification: Isolated tree-planning change. Baseline fails the scaling assertion; candidate passes. No native timing claim.

persistenceQualification.qualification: Separate persistent-profile shutdown/restart check, not a power-loss simulation or a benchmark sample.

historical.qualification: Historical CPU profiles use separate symbol-bearing WASM artifacts. The c90 upstream commit did not change checksum, overflow or B-tree planning code, but old sampled timings are not subtracted from new headline results. Historical persistence verified clean restart, not hardware power-loss durability.
